title: GameMaker Library: Brandish added, 85 assets
body:
Brandish is in the GameMaker Library from today, new here first: it has no page of its own yet. That makes 85 assets on this page. If you own the library, download again from your itch.io library at no extra cost: the whole library holds it in the folder for combat, spells and battle, and NEW 2026-11-10: Brandish only holds Brandish alone, so you only download what changed.

What Brandish is

  • A melee system for top down and side view GameMaker games in pure GML, with a runnable demo room, THE TRAINING YARD: a hero, five straw dummies and a rack of all eight weapons.
  • Three input modes: press to swing with a three hit combo and a finisher, a weapon that orbits the player toward the cursor and spins while you hold, and cursor drags whose speed sets the damage.
  • Every hit is tested along the whole arc the blade swept since the last frame, so a fast swing never passes through a target. In the test suite a swing covering 87 degrees in one frame hits the target it passed over, while a test of the blade as it stands misses it at both frames.
  • Knockback, hit stop, one hit per swing, and a wall push back that keeps the blade outside your solids, given as rectangles or as your own test.
  • 8 weapons (sword, dagger, greatsword, spear, axe, hammer, scythe, rapier) times 5 smear styles (crescent, ink brush, pixel, flame, frost) is 40 presets, all recolourable, with ghost afterimages and sparks in each style's own kind. Every smear, spark and weapon is drawn in code; no sprite art ships, and you can hand it your own weapon sprite.

It is the first of three Swing, Smash and Soar systems for action adventure games.

The library now holds 85 assets worth $1,079.15 bought one by one, for $19.99; 8 of them are combat, spells and battle. Every new asset joins on its launch day. Try the free sampler, Drawn in Code, and if the library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made with AI tools: the code and the store images.
